# RNA - Protein Overlap
```{r}
# Extracting ensembl IDs of diff exp RNA
filt_de_gene_ensembl_id <- rna_DPSC_vs_iN_filt %>% 
  select(gene_id, gene_name, status) %>% 
  rename(rna_status = status)
  

# Extracting ensembl IDs and Uniprot IDs of diff exp prot
filt_de_prot_id <- ms_data_tmt_human_only_diff_analysis_results_limma %>% 
  filter(status != "Insignificant") %>% 
  select(gene_id, accession, status) %>% 
  separate_longer_delim(gene_id, delim = ";") %>% 
  mutate(gene_id = str_trim(gene_id)) %>% 
  rename(prot_status = status)

# Overlap of RNA and Proteins
rna_prot_overlap_id <- inner_join(filt_de_prot_id, filt_de_gene_ensembl_id)

rna_prot_diff_list <- list(rna_up = rna_DPSC_vs_iN_filt %>% filter(status == "Upregulated") %>% pull("gene_name"),
                              rna_down = rna_DPSC_vs_iN_filt %>% filter(status == "Downregulated") %>% pull("gene_name"),
                              prot_up = ms_data_tmt_human_only_diff_analysis_results_limma %>% filter(status == "Upregulated") %>% pull("gene_name"),
                              prot_down = ms_data_tmt_human_only_diff_analysis_results_limma %>% filter(status == "Downregulated") %>% pull("gene_name"))

ggvenn::ggvenn(rna_prot_diff_list, set_name_size = 4, show_percentage = FALSE, text_size = 6) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1)
```
